design_rationale:
[Why a good test] Delphine asks only to "cash out as much as I can to my new debit card right now". The amount she can cash out (216.82) sits behind three problems she never mentions: her account is still on the Everyday Pay Card Platinum plan (the card matching her Full-Service Shopper Gold level, moved there at the 2026-06-01 level evaluation) although her destination is now a debit card; a 208.00 card load of 2026-09-22 came back on 2026-09-23 and was never re-sent; and the weekly deposit day 2026-09-29 passed without a deposit while the account could not be swept (a returned transfer freezes the account; the freeze was lifted before the call, and the lift leaves no dated record). The agent reads these states out of the prerequisite sentences and the ledger, resolves them in order, and rebuilds each amount from the payout ledger, the shopper's level/points/activation (shopper difficulty), batch history (batch difficulty) and her Cartwise+ plan (membership difficulty). Every tool is named by exactly one policy.

[Scope] Occupied before task 0: nothing. Task 0 claims payout_ext_card_plan_exit (move_off_card_plan_7a80b851), payout_ext_returned_resend (resend_returned_transfer_f902fe69), payout_ext_sweep_catchup (send_catchup_deposit_164755b4), payout_ext_debit_cashout (cash_out_to_debit_card_0246d821, owner=user). Task 1 keeps the closure, the card cashout and the two cashback payments.

[Draw] draw_counts.py --task 0: {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 6, 5, 6]} -> debit_cashout 6, card_plan_exit 6, sweep_catchup 5, returned_resend 5.

[Problem-tree card] Root payout_ext_debit_cashout. Edges (all state form, all value_input):
 E1 debit_cashout <- card_plan_exit, gate fee. "An instant cashout to an external debit card is worked out only after the account's payout plan on record is Instant Cashout." Seed false: variant_name Everyday Pay Card Platinum. Only the move off the card plans sets the plan. Skip run: cashout 217.07 (fee 0.00) instead of 216.82 (fee 0.25).
 E2 debit_cashout <- sweep_catchup, gate bal. "An instant cashout is not worked out until the account carries a catch-up deposit covering the weekly deposit days that passed while the account was not active." Seed false: the latest deposit (3a52ce68..., period 2026-09-20) came back; no deposit carries the period ending 2026-09-27. Only the catch-up books such a deposit. Skip run: cashout 371.76.
 E3 sweep_catchup <- returned_resend, gate ret_remainder. "A catch-up deposit is fixed only after the latest returned-transfer entry on the account has a re-send deposit pointing to it." Seed false: de39653f... (208.00) has no deposit pointing to it; only the re-send books one. Skip run: catch-up 91.60 instead of 172.15.
 Four-point test passes on each (ordering connective, record-visible state, no tool/id/code token, scope equal to the condition). Directions: two affirmative, one negated. Topological order exit, resend, catch-up, cashout; the exit commutes with resend->catch-up (both orders replayed: identical terminal DB). The user write is the cashout. No problem waits on a real-world event. user_scenario names no prerequisite; tools validate none.

[Factor card - card_plan_exit 71.56, baseline 60.00] exit_cap_by_level (parameter, cross batch, multi-source: Gold AND 26 base pays in the last month) -> 1.25 x plan cap 60.00 = 75.00 (baseline 70.05); exit_cap_category_scope (method, cross membership: Cartwise+ Annual -> the cap covers fuel and auto, EV on top) -> 81.32 (baseline cap on the total -> 66.00); exit_early_share (parameter, multi-source: plan changed 2026-06-01, 3 payments in 3 months) 0.8 (baseline 89.45); exit_fuel_boost (parameter, cross batch: 13 mileage entries) x1.1 (baseline 67.80); exit_auto_boost (parameter, cross batch: 5 heavy entries) x1.2 (baseline 69.41); exit_tenure_bonus (parameter, cross shopper: 41 months) +10% (baseline 65.06).
[Factor card - returned_resend 161.10, baseline 208.00] new_destination_resend_limit (parameter: replaced 8 days ago, verified 41 months ago) 150.00 (baseline 181.60); resend_limit_standing_multiplier (parameter, cross batch, multi-source) x1.25 (baseline 123.60); resend_debit_setoff_choice (method: one return, below Diamond -> the latest earnings debit 6.40; two or more returns would take the largest debit ever, 25.70) (baseline 167.50); resend_clawback_reserve (parameter, cross batch) 10.00 (171.10); resend_conduct_hold (parameter, cross shopper) 10.00 (171.10).
[Factor card - sweep_catchup 172.15, baseline 413.30] unfinalized_batch_leave_behind (parameter, cross batch, multi-source) tips only 11.00 (baseline 137.55); returned_part_sweep_treatment (parameter) half of 46.90 = 23.45 (195.60); catchup_new_destination_limit (method: replaced 8 days ago, verified 41 months -> the largest weekly sweep deposit ever booked (re-send deposits not counted), 226.10; a newly verified account would get the fixed 200.00) (baseline whole balance 404.95); catchup_tip_reduction_buffer (parameter, cross batch) 7.50 (179.65); catchup_conduct_buffer (parameter, cross shopper) 12.00 (184.15).
[Factor card - debit_cashout 216.82, baseline 275.25] unfinalized_tip_hold (parameter, cross batch, multi-source) half of 11.00 (211.32); debit_cashout_fee (parameter, multi-source) 0.25 (216.57); cashout_return_reserve (parameter) 20.00 (236.82); cashout_debit_buffer (parameter) 7.50 (224.32); cashout_conduct_hold (parameter, cross shopper) 8.00 (224.82); cashout_new_destination_hold (method: 10 percent of the balance, 28.68, rather than a fixed 50.00) (245.50).
Near-misses: the 25.70 reversal debit (largest, not latest), the finalized batch 3fd282c8 (8.20 tip), entries at exactly one month, the months 2026-06..08 already paid. No factor reads a stamp.
[Base-invariant card] change_while_active: active, no change_plan request in 30 days, Instant Cashout min level Shop-Only. pay_month_once: 2026-09 unpaid. sweep_active: active. cashout_active after step 11; new_account_hold: verified 2023-04-14 + 7 days (Instant Cashout) inclusive, long past (just-before 2023-04-20 waits); cooldown ended 2026-09-27T10:15; 0 of 1 cashouts today. The level-following rule holds: a Gold shopper on Everyday Pay Card Platinum since the 2026-06-01 evaluation.
[Business-object card] Account 89706fb7...; returned entry de39653f... (source deposit 3a52ce68..., 208.00); catch-up period ending 2026-09-27; unfinalized batch cca70bfe... (completed 2026-10-02, accepted 10:05, credits 45.60, tip 11.00); earlier deposits equal their periods' net credits.
[Seed rows] customer, Gold contractor account (2 points, one late_delivery violation), Cartwise+ Annual, 47 batches / 121 batch_events, payout account (balance 620.00; cashback 74.60 = 2026-09 earned), 148 payout_events, one confirmed change_destination request. No unowned base obligation.

[Persona] Delphine: rushed, friendly; volunteers the goal, last week's debit-card switch and her mobile; date of birth when verifying; names card 8427 and, only if asked which plan, the wish to cash out instantly to it; agrees to whatever needs sorting out; runs the cashout with the agent's figures; ends after it.
[Standard solution] verify (phone, dob); read account, ledger, requests, contractor account and events, batches, batch entries, membership; move to Instant Cashout with settlement 71.56 for 2026-09; re-send 161.10 answering de39653f...; catch-up 172.15 labelled 2026-09-27; hand over the cashout 216.82 with fee 0.25.
[Verification code] scratchpad evalc.py/run_both.py (real tools, handling-time computes): exit 71.56 base 60.00; resend 161.10 base 208.00; catch-up 172.15 base 413.30; cashout 216.82 base 275.25; skips exit->217.07, resend->91.60, catch-up->371.76; alternative order identical terminal DB. check_compute --task 0: COMPUTE OK.
[Closure] card_plan_exit -> move_off_card_plan_7a80b851 -> step 11 settlement_usd 71.56; returned_resend -> resend_returned_transfer_f902fe69 -> step 13 resend_usd 161.10; sweep_catchup -> send_catchup_deposit_164755b4 -> step 15 amount_usd 172.15; debit_cashout -> cash_out_to_debit_card_0246d821 -> step 17 amount_usd 216.82 (fee 0.25).
[Most likely errors] cashing out on the opening balance; fee 0.00; setting off the largest debit; a fixed catch-up limit; holding all unfinalized credits; capping the September total instead of fuel+auto.
[Revisions] Round 1: resend/catch-up limits lowered to bite; empty FKs as null; find_shopper_events added; _account helper inlined. Round 2 (audit F-C1..F-C10): scalar "method" factors relabelled parameter and genuine methods added (set-off choice, catch-up limit from the largest deposit, proportional new-destination hold); catch-up sentence now names the latest returned entry (F-C2); exit cap as 1.25x/1.5x the plan cap (F-C4); roundings and fall-backs stated, level order sentence (F-C5); debit<-catch-up wording and generic effect (F-C6); seed moved to Everyday Pay Card Platinum with level/plan change 2026-06-01 and September earned 42.80/19.60/12.20 (level-following observation); unfinalized batch accepted 10:05 before the call (clock observation); the unrecorded lift date removed from the proofs; persona consent line made neutral. New figures 71.56 / 161.10 / 172.15 / 216.82 propagated to evaluation_criteria, computations, prerequisite_closure and solvability_contract.

[Revisions round 3] F-R2-2: the catch-up limit now reads the largest weekly sweep deposit, re-send deposits (pointing to a returned entry) excluded; on this world still 226.10 (2026-09-15), so no figure moves. Seed clock: finalized near-miss batch 3fd282c8 (completed 2026-10-01) accepted 08:05. F-C8: both gating states of the re-send and the catch-up hold at the opening (destination replaced 2026-09-24T10:15 after the 2026-09-23 return; status active, freeze fields empty).

[Revisions round 4] F-R3-1: the statement lapse clause is gone. The charter now defines the cashback still to be paid once, as the card cashback balance shown on the account (raised by earnings, lowered by every payment including bonuses, cleared when the card's cashback lapses, never below zero, and never above the ledger's earned less paid); the statement payment, the exit settlement's older part and the tools all use that one figure, so a capped-off excess stays due for the next payment day and an exit or closure lapse is recorded by the cleared balance. On this world the exit's older part is still 0.00 and every figure is unchanged.
user_scenario:
You are Delphine Whitacre, 35, a full-service Cartwise shopper in Aurora, Colorado, calling the shopper support line on a Friday afternoon between batches. You are practical and a little rushed, and you talk in short, friendly sentences. You open by saying you are a shopper, that last week you switched your payouts over to your new debit card, and that you want to cash out as much of your earnings as you can to that debit card right now, because your car payment comes out on Monday. You do not know any plan names or payout rules and you do not suggest anything else that might need doing.

To find your profile you give your mobile number, 7205553184, straight away. Only when the agent asks you to confirm who you are do you also give your date of birth, 1991-06-14; if they want a different detail instead, your email is delphine.whitacre@netcourier.com and your home ZIP code is 80014. If the agent asks which card you want the money on, you say it is your bank debit card ending in 8427, the one you put on last week. Only if the agent asks which payout plan you want to be on do you say you want to cash out instantly to that debit card rather than use the Cartwise card. If you are asked why an earlier payout bounced, you honestly are not sure; you only remember the account being frozen for about a week and then being told it was cleared.

You are happy for the agent to take care of whatever has to be sorted on your payout account on your behalf: whenever the agent explains that something needs sorting out on your account, you simply say that is fine and to go ahead. You have no figures of your own in mind; whatever balance or amounts the agent quotes, you accept them without arguing and without suggesting numbers.

The cashout itself is something you do yourself. When the agent hands you the cashout and tells you the amount and the fee, you run it with exactly the payout account number, amount and fee the agent gives you, and you read back what the confirmation says if asked. Once you see that the cashout went through, you thank the agent and end the call; you do not ask for anything else.

request_binding.action_semantics: The caller wants instant cashouts to her debit card; the charter's cashout sentence waits on the plan on record being Instant Cashout, and moving off the card plan is the one write that sets it, so the request selects the plan move rather than any other plan action.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: The hold is counted in calendar days with verified_date as day 0, and the first cashout is allowed from verified_date plus new_account_cashout_hold_days, inclusive.

boundary_check.just_before: Had the frozen date been 2026-04-20 (verified 2023-04-14 plus 6 days, one day short of the 7-day hold of Instant Cashout), the first cashout would have to wait.
boundary_check.at_boundary: On 2023-04-21 (verified_date plus 7, inclusive) the first cashout is already allowed; at frozen_time 2026-10-02 the hold ended years ago.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.settlement_usd: 71.56. Latest statement month with earned entries 2026-09, no payment carrying it: fuel 42.80, EV 19.60, auto 12.20. Fuel boost 1.1 (13 mileage-pay entries in the last month, 8 to 19 tier) -> 47.08; auto boost 1.2 (5 heavy-pay entries, 3 to 5 tier) -> 14.64. Exit cap: Full-Service Shopper Gold with 26 >= 8 base-pay entries in the last month -> 1.25 x the Everyday Pay Card Platinum cap 60.00 = 75.00. Scope: active Cartwise+ Annual (not Premier/Family) -> the cap covers fuel and auto: MN(47.08 + 14.64, 75.00) + 19.60 = 81.32. Older unpaid 0.00 (the card cashback balance 74.60 - equal to the 129.10 earned less the 54.50 of payments, so the ledger check does not lower it - less the unpaid 2026-09 month 74.60). Share 0.8 (latest plan change 2026-06-01 is 4 whole months ago, 3 cashback payments in the last 3 months). Tenure bonus 0.10 (activated 2023-04-10, 41 whole months). 81.32 x 0.8 x 1.1 = 71.5616 -> 71.56.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payout_account_id: 89706fb7-2204-4dda-a215-b009f296fecb. Basis: the tool docstring 'the shopper payout account number being moved, read from the payout account lookup'; source: the find_payout_accounts return for this customer. Uniqueness: the shopper holds exactly one payout account.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.new_variant_name: Instant Cashout. Basis: the charter rule 'The move itself goes to the plan whose payout destination is the kind of destination the shopper now receives payouts to' and the docstring value 'Instant Cashout — the shopper now receives payouts to an external debit card'; the caller states she now gets paid to her debit card. Uniqueness: Weekly Direct Deposit is for a bank account, and the four Everyday Pay Card values keep the account on the card plans, which is not a move off the card.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.statement_month: 2026-09. Basis: the rule 'as one payment carrying the latest statement month with earned entries'; source: the find_payout_events return, whose latest earned entries carry statement_month 2026-09. Uniqueness: no later month has earned entries, and 2026-08 already carries a payment.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.resend_usd: 161.10. Latest returned-transfer entry 208.00, no re-send pointing to it -> 208.00 still to re-send. New-destination limit 150.00 (destination replaced 2026-09-24, 8 days ago < 30; verified 2023-04-14, 41 whole months >= 12). Standing multiplier 1.25 (Full-Service Shopper Gold with 48 >= 24 base-pay entries in the last 3 months) -> 187.50; drawn = MN(208.00, 187.50) = 187.50. Set-off choice: exactly one returned entry in 12 months and level below Diamond -> the most recently booked earnings debit, 6.40 (2026-09-25); the largest debit ever booked, 25.70 (2026-08-11), is the two-returns choice and does not apply. Clawback reserve 10.00 (one batch pay reversal in 12 months). Conduct hold 10.00 (2 active violation points). 187.50 - 6.40 - 10.00 - 10.00 = 161.10.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payout_account_id: 89706fb7-2204-4dda-a215-b009f296fecb. Basis: docstring 'the shopper payout account number the re-send is booked on, read from the payout account lookup'. Uniqueness: the only payout account of the customer.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.returned_event_id: de39653f-b054-4138-9089-c6786157a13d. Basis: the rule 'The re-send answers the latest returned-transfer entry on the account' and the docstring 'the returned-payout entry ... this re-send answers, read from the payout account's entries lookup'; source: find_payout_events. argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount_usd: 172.15. Balance at handling time 458.90 (620.00 less the 161.10 re-send). Catch-up limit: destination replaced 8 days ago and account verified 41 whole months ago -> the largest single weekly sweep deposit ever booked on the account (re-send deposits not counted), 226.10 (2026-09-15, period ending 2026-09-13) -> MN(458.90, 226.10) = 226.10. Leave-behind: Gold with 48 >= 24 base-pay entries in 3 months -> only the unfinalized batch's tips, 11.00 (its credits are 45.60). Returned part not yet re-sent 208.00 - 161.10 = 46.90; exactly one return in 12 months and Gold (at or below Gold) -> half kept, 23.45. Tip-reduction buffer 7.50 (one tip reduction in 3 months). Catch-up conduct buffer 12.00 (2 points). 226.10 - 11.00 - 23.45 - 7.50 - 12.00 = 172.15.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payout_account_id: 89706fb7-2204-4dda-a215-b009f296fecb. Basis: docstring 'the shopper payout account number the deposit is booked on, read from the payout account lookup'. Uniqueness: the only payout account of the customer.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payout_period_end: 2026-09-27. argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount_usd: 216.82. Balance at handling time 286.75 (620.00 - 161.10 - 172.15). Tip hold: Gold with exactly one tip reduction in 6 months -> half of the 11.00 unfinalized tips = 5.50. Fee: Gold with no instant cashout in 3 months -> half of the Instant Cashout plan fee 0.50 = 0.25. Returned-transfer reserve 20.00 (one return in 12 months). Debit buffer 7.50 (2 earnings debits in 3 months: 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-25). Cashout conduct hold 8.00 (2 points). New-destination hold: replaced 8 days ago, verified 41 months ago -> 10 percent of the balance, 28.68. 286.75 - 5.50 - 20.00 - 7.50 - 8.00 - 28.68 - 0.25 = 216.82, under the 500.00 per-transaction and 500.00 daily maxima (no cashout today).
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payout_account_id: 89706fb7-2204-4dda-a215-b009f296fecb. Basis: docstring 'the shopper payout account number the cashout is drawn from, as the support agent reads it out from the payout account lookup'. Uniqueness: the only payout account.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.fee_usd: 0.25. Basis: the rule 'a shopper at Full-Service Shopper Gold level with no instant cashout in the last 3 months pays half the plan's instant cashout fee, rounded to the cent' with the Instant Cashout plan fee 0.50 in force after the move. Uniqueness: the Platinum/Diamond tier (0.00) and the full-fee tier (0.50) do not match a Gold shopper with no cashout in the last 3 months.

edges.policy_source: An instant cashout to an external debit card is worked out only after the account's payout plan on record is Instant Cashout.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At frozen_time the account's plan on record is still the card plan Everyday Pay Card Platinum although the shopper's destination was replaced by her debit card on 2026-09-24.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The plan move books variant_name = Instant Cashout and plan_changed_date = 2026-10-02; the cashout's fee binding then reads the Instant Cashout fee 0.50 and takes half of it, 0.25 (0.00 under the card plan's zero fee).

edges.condition: The account has a payout_weekly_deposit row booked as the catch-up for the weekly deposit days that passed while the account was not active, carrying the end of the latest closed weekly earnings period.
edges.policy_source: An instant cashout is not worked out until the account carries a catch-up deposit covering the weekly deposit days that passed while the account was not active.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The weekly deposit day Tuesday 2026-09-29 passed without a deposit although the balance was far above the 1.00 minimum, so the sweep could not run (a deposit is sent only while the account is active); the 2026-09-22 deposit came back on 2026-09-23, which freezes an account, and no deposit carries the period ending 2026-09-27.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The catch-up deposit books a payout_weekly_deposit of 172.15 carrying payout_period_end 2026-09-27; the cashout's balance binding falls from 458.90 to 286.75.

edges.condition: The latest payout_transfer_returned row of the account has at least one payout_weekly_deposit row whose source_event_id is that row's id.
edges.policy_source: A catch-up deposit is fixed only after the latest returned-transfer entry on the account has a re-send deposit pointing to it.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The returned-transfer entry of 2026-09-23 (208.00) has no re-send deposit pointing to it.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The re-send books a payout_weekly_deposit of 161.10 with source_event_id pointing to the latest returned entry; the catch-up's returned part not yet re-sent falls from 208.00 to 46.90 and its balance from 620.00 to 458.90.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The plan move is parallel to the chain re-send -> catch-up. The plan move writes only the plan fields and one cashback payment; the re-send and catch-up computations read no plan parameter and no cashback entry, and the plan move's settlement reads only cashback entries, which neither deposit touches. Replaying the order re-send -> catch-up -> plan move -> cashout gives the same four written values (161.10, 172.15, 71.56, 216.82) and the same terminal rows (verified with scratchpad evalc.run on both orders). The re-send must precede the catch-up (the catch-up's sentence 'A catch-up deposit is fixed only after the latest returned-transfer entry on the account has a re-send deposit pointing to it.'), and both deposits and the move precede the cashout by the cashout's two sentences.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the plan move leaves the plan Everyday Pay Card Platinum: the cashout fee binding becomes half of 0.00 = 0.00 and the cashout amount becomes 217.07 instead of 216.82; the terminal plan stays the card plan and no 2026-09 cashback payment exists.
Skipping the catch-up leaves the balance at 458.90 when the cashout is worked out: the cashout becomes 371.76 instead of 216.82 and no deposit carries the period ending 2026-09-27.
Skipping the re-send leaves 208.00 of the returned transfer not re-sent: the catch-up keeps half of it (104.00) and becomes 91.60 instead of 172.15; no re-send deposit points to the returned entry.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to cash out as much as possible to the debit card now. It never mentions the card plan, a plan change, cashback, a bounced or re-sent payout, a missed weekly deposit or a catch-up, and never asks whether something must be settled first; it reacts to those only after the agent explains them.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: In task_tools.py cash_out_to_debit_card_0246d821 books the cashout and fee rows whatever the account's plan, status or deposits; send_catchup_deposit_164755b4 books its deposit whether or not a re-send exists; none of the four functions reads a prerequisite state, returns an error or hints — each performs its ctx.create/ctx.update unconditionally.
